  "agent_id": "your-agent",
  "intent": "buy_market_research",
  "budget": 25,
  "risk_tolerance": "low",
  "preferred_settlement": "stablecoin",
  "required_confidence": 80
}Illustrative advisory request; inspect the API contract for required fields. This request does not execute or pay.
